skill.name: flux-kontext
skill.description: Use Flux 1 Kontext Pro through the RunComfy CLI for precise single-image edits. The skill explains model selection, prompt patterns, input fields, output handling, limitations, and security notes for image URLs, tokens, and downloads.
skill.summary: Run Flux 1 Kontext Pro edits with RunComfy using focused prompts and one source image.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are Markdown documentation false positives, including code fences, sample URLs, and ellipsis paths. The real risks are intentional RunComfy CLI execution, outbound calls to RunComfy, generated file downloads, and third-party processing of image prompts. No evidence found for prompt injection or malicious exfiltration instructions.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running RunComfy commands, and keep command arguments structured instead of shell-concatenated.
Warn users that prompts and image URLs go to RunComfy, and advise against sensitive images without consent.
Document token revocation, prefer RUNCOMFY_TOKEN in CI, and verify owner-only permissions for local token files.
Keep the download allowlist and size cap, and resolve output directories before writing files.

content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Precise image edits often fail when prompts combine too many changes or use the wrong model. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code route single-image edits to Flux Kontext Pro through RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Selects Flux Kontext Pro for precise edits on one source image.
Provides RunComfy CLI commands for prompt, image, seed, and output directory inputs.
Explains preservation-led prompt patterns for identity, layout, brand, and lighting.
Compares when to use sibling image models instead.
Documents expected exit codes, authentication, endpoints, and output download behavior.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account and local RunComfy CLI setup.
Uses one publicly fetchable HTTPS image as the source input.
Does not support batch edits or multi-reference image workflows.
Prompt results can drift when several changes are requested at once.

use_cases.title: Retouch a Product Image
use_cases.description: Change one label, color, or prop while preserving the source composition.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Make focused visual variants from approved source assets without rebuilding the scene.

use_cases.title: Automate Model Calls
use_cases.description: Use RunComfy CLI examples to submit image edits from a local workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Local Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro to edit this source image: [image URL]. Keep the person, pose, and framing unchanged. Add [single object or change].

prompt_templates.title: Brand Text Swap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro on [image URL]. Keep the product shape, lighting, and background unchanged. Replace only the label text from [old text] to [new text].

prompt_templates.title: Seeded Variant Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a Flux Kontext Pro edit on [image URL] with seed [number]. Keep [protected elements] unchanged. Change [one element]. Save outputs to [directory].

prompt_templates.title: Model Routing Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this edit request: [request]. Decide whether Flux Kontext Pro is the right model. If yes, prepare a preservation-first prompt and RunComfy inputs.

output_examples.input: A portrait needs a small prop added without changing the face or outfit.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Flux Kontext Pro and returns a preservation-first prompt that adds the prop while protecting identity, pose, clothing, and framing.

output_examples.input: A product bottle label must change from ALPHA to AURA.
output: Use a single source image URL.
Keep bottle shape, table, and lighting unchanged.
Replace only the quoted label text.

output_examples.input: A request asks for edits across ten source images.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that Flux Kontext Pro is not the best fit and recommends a batch-capable image edit model.

best_practices: Use one declarative edit instruction per run.
State the elements that must stay unchanged before the requested change.
Use a seed when comparing variants or repeating a review.
anti_patterns: Do not combine several unrelated edits in one prompt.
Do not pass private image URLs unless third-party processing is allowed.
Do not use this model for multi-image or text-to-image workflows.

faq.question: Do I need RunComfy?
faq.answer: Yes. A RunComfy account and CLI are required before running the model.

faq.question: Can it edit several images at once?
faq.answer: No. This skill is designed for one source image per run.

faq.question: Does it upload my image?
faq.answer: The RunComfy model server receives the prompt and source image URL for processing.

faq.question: Can I use local image files?
faq.answer: The documented schema expects a publicly fetchable HTTPS image URL.

faq.question: What makes prompts more reliable?
faq.answer: Protect identity, layout, lighting, and brand details before describing one change.

faq.question: Does the skill install the RunComfy CLI?
faq.answer: No. It documents the required CLI installation and commands.
